raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.16.0"

package:
  name: python-confluent-kafka
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/confluent-kafka/confluent_kafka-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8268b8763a0c0503a99a55a9cac0132ed010932135d4222f67e2c804d1597508
  patches:
    - if: win
      then: 0001-Fix-setup-for-windows.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=62
    - wheel
    - librdkafka >=${{ version }}
  run:
    - python
    - librdkafka >=${{ version }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - confluent_kafka
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      # Exercises the compiled extension and its link against librdkafka.
      - python -c "import confluent_kafka; print(confluent_kafka.version(), confluent_kafka.libversion())"
    requirements:
      run:
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/confluentinc/confluent-kafka-python
  repository: https://github.com/confluentinc/confluent-kafka-python
  documentation: https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/confluent-kafka-python/html/index.html
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Confluent's Apache Kafka client for Python
  description: |
    Confluent's Kafka client for Python wraps the librdkafka C library,
    providing full Kafka protocol support with great performance and
    reliability.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - lpsinger
    - rmax
    - mrocklin
    - mariusvniekerk
